title: Instrument storage requests and returned streams
task_aliases: get ranges bytes stream list multipart errors
brief: The returned wrapper observes calls made through it. Registration and use of the wrapped instance determine whether query I/O reaches that boundary.

choices.tradeoff: The consumer must actually use this instance.
Query results can be the same with a different trace.

claims.statement: instrument_object_store takes an Arc<dyn ObjectStore> and &str name and returns Arc<dyn ObjectStore>.
Method completion and consumption of returned streams are distinct. Inspect each method: a span around returning GetResult is not proof of payload-transfer coverage.
instrument_result records result metadata or error text and returns the original Result.

Direct wrapped and underlying in-memory store calls return identical bytes/ranges; only the wrapper emits store spans. Missing-path errors are recorded, get closes before bytes consumption, and list stays live until consumed. Registration into a DataFusion runtime is not exercised.

implementation: Wrap the store before passing it to the consuming storage registration point.
Check target and concrete method; lazy streams/multipart operations need their own boundary evidence.
unknowns: Local controlled storage does not qualify cloud retries, authentication or network traffic.

evidence.scope: Retained exact-release source or documentation; local runtime assertions are linked separately.
